about: Datasets and annotations of the Liver Tumour Intelligence Platform V11. 'files' lists every bundled file with its SHA-256 (install.py verifies them). Research use only; not for clinical use.

datasets/CT: dataset/liver_ct_lits_verified_v8 (full CT dataset, NOT INCLUDED in this package — see full_dataset)
datasets/annotations: data/labels/verified_slice_labels.csv (all 1,745 slices of the full dataset)
masks/ inside the full dataset (expert segmentation masks; not included)

lits_sample.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (inherited from LiTS via the Hugging Face source)
lits_sample.ground_truth: label_tumour = any tumour pixel in the expert mask; liver_px_512 / tumour_px_512 = mask pixel counts at 512x512

synthetic.use: software tests and OOD-rejection checks only; never used to train or evaluate a reported model

full_dataset.contents: 1,745 axial CT slices (512x512 PNG, 476 with tumour) in 10 reconstructed scan groups, 2,449 96x96 training patches, expert masks, labels, verification records
full_dataset.verification: dataset/manifests/lits_verified_v8_SHA256SUMS.txt (SHA-256 of every file); cd dataset/liver_ct_lits_verified_v8 && sha256sum -c ../manifests/lits_verified_v8_SHA256SUMS.txt   (macOS: shasum -a 256 -c ...)
full_dataset.source: pixel-matched to the Hugging Face dataset seongun/liver-tumor-classification, derived from the LiTS benchmark; labels re-derived from the expert masks
full_dataset.citation: P. Bilic et al., The Liver Tumor Segmentation Benchmark (LiTS), Medical Image Analysis 84, 102680 (2023), doi:10.1016/j.media.2022.102680
full_dataset.how_to_restore: copy the folder from the V9/V10 project (dataset/liver_ct_lits_verified_v8) into dataset/, verify it with the SHA-256 list, then: python install.py --check (see DATASET_GUIDE.md and MISSING_ARTIFACTS.md)
full_dataset.why_not_included: the full dataset folder was not present in the source workspace this package was built from (the V10 folder held the lean release); it was not fabricated or replaced

mri.note: No MRI data and no MRI-trained model exist in any version of this project. An upload marked MRI is flagged as out of scope (every model is CT-trained) and is expected to be withheld by the out-of-distribution check; nothing was fabricated.

patient_level: The source has no patient or volume identifiers; units are reconstructed scan groups (never reported as patients).
